Chewy Thai coconut cakes are among the most popular street foods in Thailand. If you’ve been fortunate enough to visit Thailand and try one (or several) of these flower-shaped, bite-sized cakes for yourself, you can certainly understand why. And even if your travels haven’t taken you to Thailand, you’re in luck, because Trader Joe’s Chewy Thai Coconut Cakes are bringing this delicacy straight to your freezer!

Following an authentic recipe, Trader Joe’s Chewy Thai Coconut Cakes are made for us in Thailand from a straightforward batter of coconut milk, sugar, tapioca starch, water, wheat flour, baking powder, and salt. We added in purple sweet potato and ube to give them their rich, purple coloring and signature flavor. When heated in the air fryer or toaster oven, these Cakes develop a nice, crisp exterior while remaining soft and chewy on the interior. What you end up with is an elegant, lightly sweet, and bouncy dessert that is a great addition to a grazing table or a handy finger food for vegan snacking.

Trader Joe’s Granola Butter begins like any good granola, with a base of rolled oats—specifically, gluten free rolled oats. The oats are blended smooth with a mix of ingredients including olive oil, brown sugar, coconut oil, maple syrup and vanilla extract, and the result is a little graham cracker-like, with hints of vanilla. It’s creamy, with just a bit of texture, and it’s wonderfully spreadable. And it's Gluten Free, Kosher (pareve) and Vegan.

We think Trader Joe’s Granola Butter is bound to be the next spreadable hit (Cookie Butter, anyone?), and recommend it on a sandwich or piece of toast, mixing it into yogurt or a smoothie, or even enjoying it straight from the jar with your favorite spoon.

If you’re familiar with Thai cuisine, chances are you’ve enjoyed Mango Sticky Rice, or khao niew mamuang, as a dessert at the end of a spicy meal. Fans of the dish understand how hard it is to find, especially when Mangoes are out of season. So, we worked with an experienced supplier in Thailand to bring our customers Trader Joe’s Mango Sticky Rice, a convenient way to enjoy this comforting and refreshing dessert all year long.

Each package includes two individual servings of perfectly ripe Mango, cubed and set atop sweet, coconut-infused Glutinous Sticky Rice, along with two packets of fried mung beans for sprinkling on top—the traditional finishing touch for this classic dessert. Just heat in the microwave for 50 seconds, sprinkle the mung beans to add a satisfying crunch, and enjoy! It’s an easy weeknight dessert, an impressive finish to a dinner party, or a delightfully tropical afternoon treat when paired with a cup of tea or coffee. Best of all, now you can create an authentic Thai restaurant dining experience at home by enjoying it after a meal of our frozen Vegetable Pad Thai or Pad See Ew.

Chewing gum used to be pretty straightforward… until it wasn’t. Somewhere around the mid-80s, all sorts of questionable additives & synthetic sweeteners started popping up and popping our literal & figurative bubbles! For instance, when you see “gum base” on most chewing gums, that’s code for all kinds of plastics. Trader Joe’s Naturally Mint Flavored Chewing Gum, however, is made with a gum base crafted with chicle, a sustainable tree sap. That base is blended with pure peppermint & spearmint oils and sweetened with good, ol’ fashioned organic cane sugar. The flavor is spot-on minty, leaving your mouth refreshed and your breath fresh. The gum is soft and stays soft while you chew for a good long time (we’re at 20 minutes and counting as we type).

You’ll likely be struck by the ingenious flip-top box in which the Gum is packaged. Be sure to pay attention to the inside-flap of that box. It’s there you’ll find another ingenious inclusion... a stash of ABC gum wrappers for easy, post-chew disposal. Need more great attributes? Happy to oblige... the gum is biodegradable (no plastic!), and the package is fully recyclable. Yes! This is the very first Chewing Gum to bear the TJ’s name, and we think you’ll agree it was well worth the wait!

items.item_title: Organic Apple Mango Fruit Sauce Crushers
items.item_story_marketing:
Typically, the fruit selected to jazz up an applesauce is relegated to a supporting role at best—but by using a blend of 60% organic apple purée and 40% organic mango puree in Trader Joe’s Organic Apple Mango Fruit Sauce Crushers, we invite apple and mango to be true co-stars, basking in the limelight (sans lime) together. The floral sweetness of the Apple is a fantastic foil to the zingy tropical notes of Mango. (Ed. Note— There are five other fantastic Fruit Sauce flavors for the choosing—visit your neighborhood Trader Joe’s to find your favorites!)

These convenient, almost drinkable pouches of applesauce have been customer favorites on our grocery shelves for many years, and for many reasons: They taste great, they’re made with all Organic ingredients, they’re pantry-friendly, so can always have them on hand, and they’re a quick & easy way to get fruit into a snack or lunchbox.

Making pizza from scratch is as easy as pie, if you start with Trader Joe’s Pizza Dough. And our Garlic & Herb Pizza Dough is a wonderful addition to our line of fresh pizza doughs, enhanced by the addition of garlic and a custom herb blend of rosemary, oregano, marjoram, thyme, basil and sage. It's as soft and easy to use as dough you’d make yourself.

When you’re ready to make your masterpiece, take the Dough out of the bag and bring it to room temperature, roll or stretch it out, and top with your favorite pizza toppings. It also makes wonderful breadsticks or even rolls, when brushed with a bit of butter or olive oil.

Take your tastebuds on a proverbial tropical getaway with a box of Trader Joe’s Pineapple Coconut Bars! These yellow Bars are sweet, tart, and oh-so-refreshing. Rich Coconut cream is complemented by the tangy verve of Pineapple juice, the mixture is sweetened with cane sugar to enhance the tropical notes of the fruit, and a bit of turmeric delivers a pop of color. This is a supremely satisfying frozen treat, equally enjoyed by adults and kids alike.

Reminiscent of a soft-serve flavor popular at theme parks, but in an easy-to-enjoy, perfectly portioned, bar-on- a-stick format, these Bars are a no-brainer dessert option for BBQs, backyard hangs, pool parties, and picnics. They also happen to be vegan and gluten free, making it easy for more of your guests to partake in the frozen Pineapple Coconut fun. Best of all, it won’t cost you a theme park ticket (or a sunburn for that matter) to enjoy.

The arrival of summer awakens a longing for an island escape, a break from the everyday grind. While a tropical vacation might be out of reach, Trader Joe’s Passion Fruit Guava Bars bring the vibrant flavors of the tropics directly to your freezer. These Bars are refreshing frozen treats that feature two distinct sections: sweet, floral Guava puree and bright, tangy Passion Fuit juice—a celebrated tropical pairing that transports you to sun-soaked shores. Their distinctive, vibrant color is enhanced by natural hues derived from beets and turmeric; true to Trader Joe’s tradition, the ingredient listing here is free from artificial flavors and synthetic colors. On top of that, our Passion Fruit Guava Bars are vegan, too. If you’re looking for something sweet and delicious for a summertime party or gathering, look no further! Bring a box of em’ poolside, beachside, or wherever the warm weather finds you. 
 
Passion Fruit Guava Bars are wonderful enjoyed as-is, but don’t let the party stop there. Pop one into a glass of chilled Trader Joe’s Prosecco for an effortlessly festive summer spritz. Whether you’re already a fan of this classic tropical duo or discovering it for the first time, our Passion Fruit Guava Bars deliver sunshine-worthy flavor—no passport required.

Just as Chinese cuisine has jiaozi and Japanese cuisine has gyoza, Korean cuisine has mandu. Estimated to have arrived in the Korean peninsula sometime in the 1500s, mandu come in a variety of shapes (some are circular, some are pyramidal, some look like little coin purses) and are stuffed with all sorts of savory fillings (pork, fish, and napa cabbage are especially common). Brought to us by a Korean supplier, Trader Joe’s Mandu have a flat, almost envelope-like shape, which makes them super easy to prep in a pan, and a satisfyingly spicy Kimchi and glass noodle filling, which makes them even easier to enjoy.

Indeed, after just a few minutes on each side in a hot pan with a bit of oil, these Mandu go from frozen to fantastically crisp, engrossingly aromatic, and ready to serve. They’re a truly convenient weeknight dinner option, especially when combined with rice and our Stir Fry Veggie Blend, and also make an excellent addition to a spread of Korean TJ’s favorites, including our Tteok Bok Ki and Kimbap. And whether they’re an appetizer or the entrée, these Kimchi Mandu take remarkably well to dipping in Yangnyeom or a quick mix of Soy Sauce and Rice Vinegar.

Want food on the table fast, without sacrificing flavor—or your budget? The freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s are always at the ready with meal building blocks to help you do just that. Case in point: Trader Joe’s Verdant Veggie Variety. 

Made for us by a Belgian supplier focused on flavorful Veggie varieties that pop on a plate and the palate, this Variety gets its Verdant influence from the likes of peas, kohlrabi, green beans, yellow beans, sugar snap peas, and yellow carrots. The tender-crisp blend is simply seasoned with salt, aromatics (including onion, garlic, fennel, and turmeric), plus a bit of lemon peel for verve, making it a savory, versatile side for just about any center-of-the-plate protein you have in mind—BBQ Cut Fresh Atlantic Salmon Fillets, perhaps? It’s also an amiable anchor to a warm pasta salad with your favorite protein and plenty of Parmigiano Reggiano. What’s more, our price on this pound of pre-seasoned, quick-cooking Veggies means you can get dinner on the table at a fraction of the cost of takeout. You’ll find them in our freezers, every day.

Tortillas are far more than just a staple for a satisfying meal. In many cultures—particularly in Mexico and throughout Latin America—they’re a fundamental part of identity, history, and daily life. Trader Joe’s Organic Flour Tortillas honor that tradition, while bringing everyday versatility to your own kitchen and are poised to become a staple in your household, too.

Made with organic wheat flour, our Organic Flour Tortillas are soft, pliable, and pleasantly chewy—ready for any and all applications. Though they’re perfectly sized for burritos, our 10-inch Organic Flour Tortillas can be enjoyed in practically any context that calls for a flour tortilla: as the foundation for burritos and cheesy quesadillas, or the vehicle of choice for scooping up sizzling fajitas. We also love them filled with meats and cheeses and rolled up to create school-and-work-ready-wraps, or rolled and sliced into pinwheel appetizers for potlucks and picnics. For a quick, churro-inspired snack, warm a Tortilla on the stovetop, slather it with butter, then sprinkle with cinnamon & sugar. (Yum.)

items.item_title: Organic Roasted Seaweed with Sea Salt
items.item_story_marketing:
Seaweed grows in the ocean—not in fields on land—so the idea of “organic” seaweed may seem a little strange. What, then, makes Trader Joe’s Organic Roasted Seaweed with Sea Salt “organic”? Well, in farming conventional seaweed, farmers typically use food-grade acid to eliminate the presence of unwanted species growing on the underwater crop. Instead of using these chemicals, however, the South Korean farmers who grow our Organic Seaweed use two natural methods to control pests. Seaweed is grown on ropes that are either attached to floating buoys, or to fixed poles in shallower tidal waters. When the buoys rotate, the seaweed is exposed to sunlight. Likewise, when the tide is low, the poles are “raised” out of the water, allowing sunlight to reach the seaweed. In both cases, it’s the exposure to sunlight that naturally controls the growth of unwanted species on the crop. Once harvested, this seaweed is roasted, cut, lightly misted with organic sunflower oil, & sprinkled with sea salt (the oil makes the salt stick.) The result is a yummy snack that is perfectly salty and rich in umami.

This snack is made even more perfect by our packaging—six, 0.17-ounce mini-packs, sold together in one, 1.05-ounce clear package. These little packs are small enough to stow anywhere—lunch boxes, desk drawers, backpacks, purses— but big enough to satisfy your savory snack cravings!

Arguably one of the greatest smells coming out of the kitchen is the aroma of peppers and onions cooking together. Add some cubed potatoes and you’ve got a tasty trio just begging to be topped with poached eggs or mixed with cured meat. The one down side to this dish is the substantial labor involved, which includes chopping and sautéing peppers; and cutting, par-cooking, and browning the potatoes. Foreseeing our customers’ need for an easier way, we created a pre-cooked, frozen version of Roasted Potatoes with Peppers & Onions. Our supplier in Italy uses a blend of herbs and spices, along with high-quality potatoes that have superior texture. The potatoes are cut uniformly to ensure even cooking, while the onions and peppers are grilled (instead of roasted) for better flavor.

Who ever said potatoes had a monopoly on tots? Trader Joe's Organic Veggie Bites don't just prove that other veggies are up to the task of tot-ness, they also show how effective they can be when working together. They're made from a multitudinous mix of organic vegetables, including carrots, onions, kale, sweet potatoes, broccoli, celery, and tomatoes, along with a bit of organic brown rice flour and dotted with crunchy sunflower seeds to provide just a bit of textural contrast. They're also just slightly larger than your standard tot, coming in at 
around one or two bites per Bite—in other words, the perfect size for dunking in your favorite dipping sauce.
After just a few minutes in either the air fryer, frying pan, or conventional oven, these vegan Bites develop a gloriously golden-brown exterior and crisp texture that goes especially well with ketchups, barbecue sauces, or even more adventurous choices like our Zhoug Sauce or Vegan Kale, Cashew & Basil Pesto. And since they're vegan, they make a natural side for our Protein Patties, an excellent base for a vegan twist on a tot casserole, or an awesome anytime snack for kids and adults alike. Try some out today—you'll be tot-ally glad you did.

Nearly every one of Shakespeare’s 154 sonnets makes some mention of flowers—roses, most frequently of all. Just imagine, then, how rhapsodic he would have waxed at the sight of Trader Joe’s Onion Flowers! “From sav’ry snackings we desire increase/That these breaded Onions might be air-fried/But appetizers should by time release/At Trader Joe’s, where they can be tried,” he might have said. Of course, since the Bard of Avon sadly never had access to a Trader Joe’s, we’ll simply have to wax for him—as will you, once you try these crispy, crunchy, blossom-cut Onions for yourself.

This classic appetizer is brought to us by a supplier in Thailand, who cuts each Onion into an attractive, flower- like pattern, dunks it in a savory-spiced (and also, as it happens, vegan) batter, and fries it to a golden brown. At home, it takes less than 15 minutes in an air-fryer (or a little longer in a conventional oven) to crisp up beautifully. We recommend serving them as hearty hors d’oeuvres at a game day get-together, cocktail party, or board game night. We also emphatically recommend pairing them with something savory, spicy, and/or creamy to dunk the Onion “petals” into—our (also vegan) Spicy Dynamite Sauce is always an excellent option.

Only a language as beautiful as Italian could make the word “drowned” so euphonious as “affogato.” Because “drowned” is what “affogato” literally translates to—an evocative reference to the act of pouring hot coffee over a scoop of cold ice cream. A gem of gelato shops the world over, we love the way an affogato mixes flavors, textures, and temperatures. So, when our buyers found this instant Affogato, we instantly knew we had to bring it to our freezers.

Made with a totally vegan recipe, each package of Trader Joe’s 2 Affogatos Vanilla Non Dairy Frozen Dessert contains two cups of Vanilla Non Dairy Frozen Dessert, each of which comes with its own packet of instant coffee. All you need to do to enjoy your very own Affogato is open up a cup, pour the contents of the instant coffee into the little well that’s already been made within the Non Dairy Dessert, then follow that up with an ounce of hot water. All at once, that iconic interplay of hot & cold and sweet & bold will unfold before your very eyes, and you’ll be ready to enjoy. We recommend it as an after-dinner treat, an afternoon indulgence, or as an anytime pick-me-up. Divertiti!

If you haven’t had a chance to try one of our non-dairy frozen desserts yet—even, and especially, if you’re normally a fan of dairy—consider the introduction of Trader Joe’s Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert to be your formal invitation. Made with a base of creamy coconut milk and flavored with both vanilla bean paste and bits of ground vanilla beans, this veritably vegan Frozen Dessert is distinctly delicious, offering a superlatively smooth texture and remarkably rich and floral Vanilla flavors in every satisfying spoonful, without an overwhelming flavor of coconut.

It’s brought to us by the same Thai supplier who produces many of our other non-dairy sweet treats, and after just one taste, you’ll see why we’ve worked with them time and again: they’ve truly figured out a way to make coconut milk feel creamier and more luscious on the palate than most standard, dairy-based ice creams out there. As such, while this Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert is great for simply enjoying in a bowl, cone, or sundae, we also find that it’s particularly suited for more complex dessert endeavors, too: we recommend using it in floats, no-bake ice cream cakes, homemade ice cream sandwiches, or milkshakes (either with our A2 Organic Whole Milk, or, if you prefer to keep it vegan, some chilled Organic Non-Dairy Unsweetened Coconut Beverage.)

items.item_title: Crustless Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam Sandwiches
items.item_story_marketing:
While some folks love nothing more than biting into a hearty crust on a sandwich, others proclaim a teary “Et tu, Mama?” when presented with a sandwich whose filling is obscured by the bread’s seemingly offensive edges. And while a ready-to-eat sandwich sans crust is not a new culinary invention by any stretch of the imagination, the ones you can find elsewhere often contain less than desirable ingredients and artificial preservatives— which is why we’re thrilled to present Trader Joe’s Crustless Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam Sandwiches as a truly tasty alternative!

Their construction is straightforward: salted peanut butter and bright strawberry jam are encased in a chewy white bread whose crusts have been crimped and removed, sealing the sweet & salty filling inside. Simply thaw at room temperature for an hour (or in the refrigerator for two), and you’ll have a handy vegan PB&J in your hands. And because they’re kept frozen until needed, you’ll always have a PB&J handy wherever the day’s adventures take you, or when your hands and/or to-do list are otherwise full. You’ll find them in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day.

Flatbreads are among the most enduring recipes within the entire global culinary canon, and for very good reason. They’re simple to make, satisfying to eat, and play a rather practical part at the dinner table, acting as a scoop for dips, a pocket for veggies and proteins, or a base for an impromptu pizza. It’s no wonder then, that flatbreads like Egyptian baladi have been a staple starch for an estimated 4,000 years. In tribute to this staggeringly lengthy tradition, we now offer Trader Joe’s Baladi Egyptian Sourdough Pocket Bread in our freezers.

Made for us by a supplier in Egypt, these versatile (and vegan) Baladi Pocket Breads take only a matter of minutes in the conventional oven, or mere seconds in the micowave, before they’re puffed up, toasty, and ready to eat. Once heated, they have a tasty, slightly tangy Sourdough tinge to their flavor profile, and are ideal for stuffing with your favorite fillings. We’re partial to going with a classic combo of Falafel, chopped cucumbers, and our Garlic Spread-Dip (especially if you want to keep things vegan), though they’re equally excellent when stuffed with our Gyros or Shawarma Chicken Thighs, too. And, of course, you can just serve them for dipping in hummus or tahini, as they do in Egypt.

So much depends upon the texture of a tortilla. Too firm, and it’ll crack when being folded into a taco. Too soft, and it’ll eat more like a crepe. To achieve the perfect balance (and, thus, a superlatively satisfyingly bite), we reached out to a vendor who uses an ingenious blend of corn and wheat in their recipe. This harmonious mix produces a tortilla that’s soft and pliable enough to properly fold around your favorite fillings, while still being strong enough to hold those fillings in the first place. Available exclusively in our West Coast and Southwest stores, Trader Joe’s Corn & Wheat Tortillas are a must-have whenever tacos, fajitas, or huevos rancheros are on the menu. We find that their tooth-sinking consistency and mild flavor makes them especially suited for loading up with Beef Birria, Pollo Asado, or well-seasoned ground beef—though you truly cant go wrong with any kind of protein or veggies, in our opinion. We’re also quite find of cutting them into triangles and frying them into chips—especially if you then smother them in salsa for homemade chilaquiles.

Ideal for warm winter meals and early spring soups, Trader Joe’s Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth is fully cooked, ready to heat and serve. The recipe begins with organically grown veggies like carrots, celery, onion, leeks, and tomatoes. These veggies, along with a carefully selected assortment of spices, are slow simmered in small batches to create broth that’s simultaneously light and incredibly rich in flavor. Use our Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth to make soups or stews, in place of milk & butter in mashed potatoes, or as a substitute for meat-based broths in gravies and sauces. For a quick winter warm-up, heat a cup of Broth and serve with crusty bread or your favorite croutons. It’s gluten free and fat free, and only 40mg of sodium per serving. You’ll find each resealable 32 fluid-ounce container of Trader Joe’s Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth in our grocery aisle, every day next to our other soups and broths.

items.item_title: Organic Apple Strawberry Fruit Sauce Crushers
items.item_story_marketing:
Applesauce has been delighting snacky children and adults for centuries, and since people started packaging it for sale, it’s been delivered in jars, tins, and even tiny little tubs. We love the jars and tubs of applesauce in our stores, and we have a special place in our heart for the innovative design behind Trader Joe’s Organic Apple Strawberry Fruit Sauce Crushers. Enjoyed by kids and the young at heart alike, these conveniently Crush-able containers hold a mix of Organic Strawberry purée blended with Organic Apple purée, for a smooth, easy-squeezy, phenomenally fruity eating experience.

Great for school lunches, quick snacks, and all sorts of general on-the-go enjoyment, our Organic Apple Strawberry Fruit Sauce Crushers are a must-have for back-to-school season.

Shall we list everything we love about Trader Joe’s Fried Shallots? Let’s! First, we love that they’re made for us by an esteemed supplier in Thailand, who specializes in crispy-fried veggies like these. Second, we love that these crispy, crunchy, super savory and richly aromatic bits of Fried Shallot provide an awesome pop of texture and flavor to practically any dish. Third, we love that they’re vegan, meaning even more folks can get in on the Fried Shallot fun. And fourth, we love that they’re available on an everyday basis at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

Of course, that’s just the start of all the things we love about this versatile, tasty topper. We also love that sprinkling of Trader Joe’s Fried Shallots will spruce up a salad, soup, or chili-laden baked potato. We adore how they wake up the flavors of a weeknight casserole or slice of leftover pizza. We’re utterly taken with the texture they add when used as a topping for a taco, burger, or sandwich. And we’d be remiss if we didn’t mention how head over heels we are over their uses in savory baking, homemade appetizer dips, or, when given a spin in the food processor, as super flavorful breading for a chicken cutlet.

Originally invented in the Joseon Dynasty as a royal dish, reserved for official banquets and state dinners, japchae is still associated with celebrations in modern-day Korea, and is often served at birthdays, weddings, and other formal festivities. Way back in the 17th century, it was primarily a veggie-based stir fry (“japchae” itself simply translates to “mixed vegetables”). It wasn’t until the 1900s that sweet potato-based glass noodles, a product of culinary cross-pollination from China, made their way into the dish, to make Japchae what we know today. All of which is to say, though japchae may have changed over the years, it’s still a celebration- worthy dish that’s emphatically fit for royalty.

Coming to us straight from a supplier in Korea, Trader Joe’s Japchae Fried Rice recontextualizes this iconic entrée into something even heartier and homier. It’s made with a base of white rice and glass noodles, along with a mix of thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms, cabbage, peppers, onions, and carrots, all of which are seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil. After just a few minutes in the microwave or on the stovetop, it serves up beautifully, offering rich aromas, savory and umami flavors, and a wide spectrum of tender textures. And for an extra special treat, we especially like it topped with a freshly fried egg.

items.item_title: Fair Trade Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar
items.item_story_marketing:
Inside the resealable zipper pouch you’ll find only one ingredient – Fair Trade Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar. Grown on sugar plantations by our suppliers, the sugar cane is cut by hand, then delivered to the mill where the juice is simply crushed from the cane. The evaporation process produces perfect sugar crystals, retaining some of the original molasses, giving its subtle caramel flavor and light, golden-brown color. Turbinado sugar is also known as Raw Sugar because it’s minimally processed (this is the raw-est form of cane sugar you’ll get – completely raw cane sugar is not suitable for consumption).

This Cane Sugar can be easily substitutable for brown sugar. Make a cinnamon streusel with 2 tablespoon of TJ’s Turbinado Sugar and 2 teaspoons of TJ’s Ground Cinnamon for cakes or cupcakes. For frosting, start with a cup of TJ’s Organic Powdered Sugar and your choice of milk, then keep adding 1 tablespoon Turbinado Sugar until your desired thickness of frosting. Or sprinkle with chopped pecans if you desire a bit of a sweet n’ salty crunch. You’ll even love it as a body, foot, or face exfoliant that you can scrub, rinse and repeat! It smells delightful and works wonders. Still need further convincing? It’s vegan, kosher certified, Fair Trade, and it’s a tremendous value for a two-pound resealable bag. You’ll find it in our grocery aisle.

By many estimates, flatbread may just be the very first recipe that humanity ever developed. Verified archaeological evidence of flatbread production goes back all the way to 12,400 BCE, but many historians postulate that its origins may actually go back as far as 30,000 BCE. Needless to say, for a dish this foundational to the history of human culinary endeavor, it’s important that we found the best possible version to bring into our bakery section. And Trader Joe’s Flatbread is just that. 

Made for us by a bakery who just so happens to specialize in flatbreads, Trader Joe’s Flatbread is everything you’d expect it to be: soft, chewy, and just a touch savory, with a structure that’s pliable enough to wrap around hearty proteins and leafy greens, while sturdy enough to not tear or fall apart under those fillings’ weight. And in addition to its uses as a wrap, it’s also great for scooping up your favorite savory and/or cool and creamy dips—whether you do so straight out of the package, or cut them into wedges and fry them into crispy chips, first. And fittingly enough for such a foundational food, our Flatbreads also make a great base for an easy, homemade flatbread pizza with all your favorite toppings.

If you share our passion for fruity frozen desserts, we’ve got just the sort of Sorbet that you’re looking for! It’s made for us by an expert supplier out of Thailand, who uses a base of sweet, tangy, and tantalizingly tart Passion Fruit purée to create this vegan, summer-seasonal treat. Bright, refreshing, and charmingly tropical, with a superlatively soft and smooth texture, Trader Joe’s Passion Fruit Sorbet might just be the tastiest way to keep cool you’ll find all summer—and it’s only at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

We recommend serving this Sorbet as an easy after-dinner dessert, as part of a sweet spread at a pool party or barbecue, or as an impromptu bit of rich, fruity refreshment whenever the mood strikes. With its tropical flavors and floral aromas, we also find that it makes a great palate cleanser for all sorts of at-home tastings, be it wine, cheese, or charcuterie. It’s an excellent ingredient in a Sorbet parfait when mixed with your favorite TJ’s yogurt (feel free to double up on the passion with our Guava Passion Fruit Greek Yogurt, and for a fun, effortless mocktail, simply add a scoop to a chilled glass of sparkling water for a phenomenally fizzy Passion Fruit Sorbet float.

It feels like we’ve all had that experience where we’re at a restaurant, enjoying a burger, or a rice bowl, or some manner of crispy appetizer, when we suddenly realize that the dish itself is rather ho-hum, and it’s the sauce it’s served with that we really like. Well, Trader Joe’s Spicy Dynamite Sauce is that sauce. Not literally, of course, but it is our version of those savory, sweet, and spicy catch-all condiments you encounter out in the world that make you think “why don’t they just bottle and sell this?” We did, dear reader. We did.

Made with a base of vegan mayo, the ingredients to our Spicy Dynamite Sauce read like a list of greatest gastronomic hits: Pickled chili peppers! Sesame oil! Garlic! Horseradish-mustard paste! It all adds up to one superlatively full-flavored profile, with notes of heat, sweet, and umami, and a captivatingly creamy texture. We like it on and with everything , and we mean everything: French fries, chicken nuggets, poke bowls, grilled salmon, roasted broccoli, baked potatoes, burgers, sandwiches, fish tacos, scrambled eggs—seriously, you name it, and this Sauce will work like Dynamite.

What’s a burger without a bun? A house without a floor or roof, that’s what—and we may be grocers, not architects, but we’re pretty sure that houses generally need floors and roofs. That’s why we offer a bevy of bun varieties on our bakery shelves, including Trader Joe’s Potato Buns. Available May through September on our bakery racks, these soft and savory Buns will provide all the structural support your burgers need for all your summer grilling or pan-fried patty needs—and they’ll taste great while doing so, too. 

Trader Joe’s Potato Buns are made from a traditional Pennsylvania Dutch-inspired recipe that swaps a bit of wheat flour for potato flour for extra body and a soft, moist texture. It’s a style that’s popular among the more elevated burger chains out there (for good reason!), and while we find it’s especially suited for our Chuck, Brisket, & Sirloin Patties, you really can’t go wrong with any patty pairing. Want to build a better burger? Give these Potato Buns a try with our Caramelized Onion & Bell Pepper Turkey Patties and plenty of melted Swiss cheese, a hearty Shrimp Burger or Salmon Burger with a citrus-y slaw, or a Quinoa Cowby Veggie Burger with plenty of spicy BBQ sauce.

This truly is a golden age of getting one’s greens in. We’d reckon that there’s never been a time in human history when so many easy and delicious vegetable options have been so available and for so reasonable a price—and Trader Joe’s Roasted Green Vegetables is a prime example. It’s made from a simple, yet profoundly effective mix of pre-chopped, cruciferous Vegetables like kale, broccoli, and Brussels sprouts, along with tender, proteinaceous, pre-shelled edamame, that are all flavored with olive oil, garlic, onion, salt, and pepper, and Roasted to perfection. Now, creating a hearty and flavorful veggie side dish for your next meal is as easy as heating up a tray in the microwave or conventional oven, serving, and enjoying! 

In fact, our favorite thing about these handy, vegan Roasted Green Vegetables is their potential for freeing up the rest of your meal planning—with the veggies out of the way, you have all the more time to consider what protein and starch to serve with them. We recommend trying them out with a seared steak and potatoes, grilled chicken breasts over pasta, marinated tofu and brown rice, or pan-fried salmon with noodles. And if you feel like personalizing your Greens, the sky’s the limit: we like them topped with a bit of grated Parmesan, a drizzle of Organic Balsamic Vinegar, or any number of our savory sauces and seasoning blends.

We have so many yummy gummy candies under our belt, it would be easy to rest on our laurels and coast for a while on this gummy momentum. But that’s not the TJ’s way! Whether we are talking about gummies, curries, or berries, our developers won’t stop until we’ve created all the best products we think our customers want and deserve. 

For example, we’ve been wanting to add Strawberry flavored Sour Belts to our candy assortment for years now. Though we’ve searched the world (literally) for a worthy supplier, we’ve found that most candy makers use artificial flavors and artificial colors. That’s not what we want to offer our customers. So, we kept searching... and our persistence has finally paid off! Meet Trader Joe’s Sour Strawberry Candy Belts. 

These long, flat, rose-colored strips are made for us by an expert gummy candy supplier in Turkey who only uses natural flavors, and colors derived from fruit & vegetable juices. Open the tub and you’ll be hit by a fragrant Strawberry aroma, like a strawberry plant that’s been basking in the summer sun. This Strawberry scent sets you up for the real payoff, found in the pleasantly chewy, sugar-covered Belts that boast a balanced, sweet & sour Strawberry flavor. And... they’re vegan!

This Sour Strawberry Candy is another notch in our belt, but even more importantly, it’s another win for our customers: delicious, naturally flavored, vegan Candy, sourced with love and available every day at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

Trader Joe’s Balsamic Vinaigrette is a big, flavorful dressing that will improve pretty much any salad to which it’s added. Have a simple bed of Romaine Lettuce, or a more daring salad beginning with our Organic Mixed Baby Kale. Our Balsamic Vinaigrette, sweet & tangy, with garlic and spices, will do those salads justice, with just a simple shake of its simple bottle. Simply brilliant.

What truly sets Trader Joe's Miso Ramen Soup apart from other instant ramens, aside from its impeccably crafted blend of seasonings, is the inclusion of a packet of sunflower oil. By adding both the packet of seasonings and the packet of oil to your cup of dry noodles before preparation, you ensure not only a delightfully savory broth, rich with flavors of miso, garlic, notes of umami and seaweed, but a silky-smooth texture for your noodles—the days of dry-textured instant noodles are over. From there, it’s simply a matter of either adding boiling water up to the cup’s fill line (or adding room temperature water up to the fill line and microwaving the entire cup for one minute, 30 seconds), stirring, and letting it sit for about six minutes before serving.

Whether served straight out of the cup for a quick lunch, or transferred to a bowl with a few more traditional fixings (we recommend adding a few slices Sriracha Flavored Baked Tofu and a few sprinkles of Nori Komi Furikake Seasoning Blend, Trader Joe’s Miso Instant Ramen Soup will deliver a ramen house experience at a student-housing price. You’ll find it in our grocery aisle.

items.item_title: GoMacro® Timeless Treasure Salted Caramel + Chocolate Chips
items.item_story_marketing:
People apply the phrase “go big, or go home” to all kinds of situations: sports, vacations, purchases...even food. GoMacro® is a family-owned protein bar company in Wisconsin that has “gone big” in our estimation. They’re making yummy bars from sustainably sourced, organic ingredients; using recipes that are as clean and balanced as can be. This “all-in” approach is precisely why we’ve started carrying GoMacro’s® Timeless Treasure Macrobars® in our stores.

Starting with a base of organic almond butter and organic coconut milk, each GoMacro® Timeless Treasure bar is then flavored with caramel-y, organic maple sugar and studded with vegan chocolate chips, along with a sprinkling of sea salt. It’s a nice mix of sweet, savory, and salty that definitely goes big on flavor, but goes even bigger on protein—each 2.3-ounce, 270-calorie bar contains 10g of it, in fact. And we’re talking organically grown, plant-based protein, as this bar is 100% vegan. (It’s also gluten-free, soy-free, certified kosher, certified organic...need we go on?) And since it’s available at Trader Joe’s on an everyday basis, you can trust that one area we didn’t go big with is its price...which means that a lot more GoMacro® Timeless Treasure Macrobars®can go home with you!

Trader Joe’s Vegetable Dumplings are made for us by a supplier in Vietnam, who carefully fills each beautifully ornate, floral-shaped wrapper with a well-seasoned mix of veggies that include chives, shiitake mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and cabbage.

At home, these veritably vegan Vegetable Dumplings take only a few minutes in the steamer, microwave, or stovetop before they’re perfectly plump and ready to eat. Like all our dim sum-inspired treats, they can be enjoyed as an appetizer, entrée, or quick snack, and really excel as part of a larger dim sum spread with some rice, stir-fried veggies, and plenty of sauces to dip in.

Combining the saltiness and sweetness of teriyaki, the umami notes of miso, the meatiness of mushrooms, and the delighftul fluffiness of a bao bun, Trader Joe’s Teriyaki Mushroom Mini Bao Buns may be mini, but every bite is mighty flavorful. Our supplier in Vietnam starts with a mix of sliced oyster, king oyster, and shiitake mushrooms, along with chopped carrots, onions, and spring onions for a nice variety of flavors and textures, then sautées them all in a rich and aromatic teriyaki miso sauce. After that, they stuff it into Mini rolls of dense and slightly sweet Bao Bun dough, which, when steamed or microwaved at home, takes on a light and fluffy consistency that consummately complements the sweet and savory veggies within.

Ready in a matter of minutes (they cook particularly quickly wrapped in a wet paper towel in the microwave), our bite-sized Teriyaki Mushroom Mini Bao Buns are stellar as a quick snack, amazing as an appetizer, and even excellent as an entrée. And if you crave variety, they also make a great addition to a larger dim sum spread, alongside some of our other frozen favorites like Chicken Shu Mai. No matter what context you serve them in, we recommend pairing them with something nice and tangy to dip them in—our Gyoza Dipping Sauce, for example, suits them superbly.

Look up in the sky–it's a bird, it's a plane, it's...Trader Joe’s Organic Super Bread! Da-da-da-da!

This amazing Bread includes organic whole wheat flour, organic rye flour, organic rolled oats, and organic millet. Its multigrain mix makes a hearty, moist crumb that sets the stage for a whole host of seedy, fruity stars. With three kinds of seeds: organic pumpkin seeds, organic flax seeds, and organic sunflower seeds, this vegan bread also contains organic carrots, organic dried apple, and organic dried banana!

Trader Joe's Organic Super Bread is wonderful when simply toasted and buttered, but it’s also versatile enough to work for sandwiches or sweet spreads. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Organic Super Bread on our bakery shelves every day.

items.item_title: Whipt™ Plant Based Dairy Free Whipped Coconut
items.item_story_marketing:
When our suppliers are challenged to provide all we need for our customers, we will occasionally source alternate products to sell in the meantime. Of course, in these cases our goal is always to provide a ‘fill-in’ that is as high-quality as what we’ve been selling all along. In the case of our current non-dairy whipped cream alternative needs, we’re working with the folks at Whipt™ to bring in their light and fluffy Plant Based Dairy-Free Coconut Whipped Topping to our stores for a limited time.

Vegan, gluten free, and kosher, Whipt™ Coconut Whipped Topping is a excellent option for finishing off baked goods, coffee drinks, and all sorts of sweet treats, while also accommodating a wide range of dietary preferences. With its luxuriously soft and airy texture texture, and delicately sweet flavor, we find that it’s especially suited for using as a topping for a brownie, a bowl of (also vegan!) Chocolate Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert, or even just a plate of fresh, cut fruit. And with the holidays just around the corner, you’re going to want to make sure you’ve Whipt™ at the ready for adding a dollop to a slice of cake after the big meal!

Roti canai is a flatbread and curry dish that originated in India in the 1800s. In the decades after its inception, Southeast Asian countries like Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand developed their own variations. And now, Trader Joe’s takes a spin on this classic combination with our Roti with Thai Red Curry.

You’ll find three Roti in each box. They’re made with wheat flour, sea salt, and rice bran oil & shortening for layered, flaky flatbreads. For the Red Curry, we mix together rich coconut milk with a considerably spicy Red Curry paste containing traditional Thai seasonings like lemongrass, birds eye chiles, spur chiles, Thai basil, and galangal (a cooling, pine-like spice, if you’re unfamiliar). We finish things off with a light-yet-filling mix of green eggplant, cabbage, and potatoes. We’d say this vegan duo is ro-teeming with bright, complex flavors and wonderfully complementary textures.

To prepare it, warm the Roti on a skillet, in the oven, or in the air fryer according to package directions. Then, thaw the Curry packet in warm water for 1-2 minutes before heating through in the microwave or on the stove. To eat it, tear off pieces of the Roti and use them to scoop up the Curry, or pour the Curry on top of the Roti. Enjoy as a quick and filling snack, or make it a flavorful dinner alongside a glass of wine or beer.

Named for the Cantonese word for “seafood,” hoisin sauce gets its moniker not by virtue of containing seafood as an ingredient (it traditionally contains no animal-derived products, sea-based or not), nor by being specifically designed for serving with seafood (although it is, indeed, great with fish.) Rather, its title comes from the fact that its rich aromas and umami undertones evoke an ineffable, subtly seafood-y quality that’s celebrated in Szechuan cuisine. To that, we’d also add that a great hoisin sauce, like Trader Joe’s Hoisin Sauce, also expresses a certain sticky sweetness, savory character, and velvety texture that make it one of the more versatile condiments you’ll ever find.

Made for us by a supplier in Thailand, who starts with a base of fermented soy bean paste, black sesame paste, and brown sugar, each batch of our full-flavored Hoisin Sauce is seasoned with a blend of aromatic spices like star anise, garlic powder, coriander seed, and Szechuan peppercorns. You may have had hoisin with roast duck, spring rolls, and noodle soups before—all excellent pairings, but that’s hardly where we’d stop. We recommend drizzling our Hoisin over stir-fried vegetables, fried rice, bánh mì sandwiches, burgers, barbecued ribs, grilled shrimp or salmon, or even just using it as a sweet and savory dip for Fries.

items.item_title: Sweet Chili Mango Complete Salad Kit
items.country_of_origin: Product of United States Product of Mexico
items.item_story_marketing:
Combining the congenial crunch of cruciferous veggies like cabbage, kale, Brussels sprouts, and radicchio, with zesty, mango-forward flavors inspired by Thai cuisine, Trader Joe’s Sweet Chili Mango Salad Kit gives you everything you need to serve a super tasty salad for your next meal—besides, we suppose, a salad bowl and some tongs. Inside each all-in-one Kit, you’ll find the aforementioned blend of crisp, shredded veggies, crunchy roasted sunflower seeds, toasted quinoa, dried bits of mango, and a Thai-style sweet and spicy vinaigrette. With just a quick toss of these ingredients, you’ll instantly have a Salad with tangy, tropical flavors and layers of complementary textures in every bite.

Equally excellent as a side as it is a main (particularly when topped with your favorite protein), we find that this vegan Salad Kit’s constituent Sweet Chili Mango flavors are especially suited for serving alongside fare like spring rolls, stir-fries, and aromatic curries. That said, we also find that its spicy and fruity aspects make it an apt choice for incorporating into seafood tacos, a base for a Tempeh bowl, or using as a topping on a Turkey Burger.

Rich in flavor, vibrantly hued, luxuriously creamy, and exhilaratingly aromatic, tikka masala is one of those dishes that’s truly capable of captivating all of one’s senses at once—even just the sound of it simmering is enough to pique our appetites. It also happens to be a dish that’s spectacularly suited to vegan variations, like the recipe we use in Trader Joe’s Tikka Masala Curry Sauce. Each batch is made with a savory, velvety base that includes onion, tomato paste, and ground watermelon seeds, and flavored with a selection of seasonings and spices including garlic, turmeric, tamarind, and ginger. Altogether, this Tikka Masala Sauce is great for crafting Curries that will enchant the senses of vegans and non-vegans alike.

Conveniently shelf table (until opened) and endlessly customizable, our Tikka Masala Curry Sauce is a great for everything from quick weeknight dinners to weekly meal prep. Simply choose your veggies (diced potatoes, peas, and cauliflower are always a good start) and a protein (tofu or lentils to keep it plant-based, chicken to keep it classic), sauté them all in a saucepan until cooked through, then add the Sauce and simmer for a few minutes. Once your Curry is ready, you’re free to serve over basmati rice or Organic Riced Cauliflower, and accessorize with sides like Naan and Mini Vegetable Samosas.

From their salty, toasty flavor to their resounding, baked-not-fried crunch, Trader Joe’s Pita Chips are true staples of the snack aisle. With their distinguished dipping power and versatility, they’re practically tailor-made for serving alongside any dip, salsa, or Mediterranean dish you can imagine. They’re just substantial enough to hold the heft of hummus, and just straightforward enough to augment the awesomeness of flavorful fare like TJ’s Almond Chipotle Dip—all while remaining light and crispy enough to support straight-from-the-bag snacking, too! You could even crumble them and use them in place of croutons in a Greek salad. Options, people.

items.item_title: Carb Savvy Tortillas made with Whole Wheat
items.item_story_marketing:
If you are not that carb savvy, you might think 9g of carbohydrates in one serving of Trader Joe’s Carb Savvy Tortillas is not that impressive. In fact, for someone watching their carbs, it’s excellent!

Carb Savvy Tortillas contain less overall carbs than regular tortillas, and the carbs they do contain are mostly from dietary fiber. Accordingly, these reduced-carb tortillas are an excellent source of dietary fiber, providing 6g per tortilla. That’s 21% of your daily recommended value of fiber!

Enjoy them just as you would less-carb-savvy tortillas. Their smaller size is great for quesadillas, jumbo tacos, or even just for snacking. Find them every day on our bread shelves.

items.item_title: Organic Apple Cinnamon Fruit Sauce Crushers
items.item_story_marketing:
The full panoply (or should we say, panapple-y) of Trader Joe’s Organic Fruit Sauce Crushers includes Apple Strawberry, Apple Mango, Apple Banana, Apple Carrot, and of course the original, Apple. Now, our latest Crush includes a fall-famous spice that’s about as apple-friendly as one could be!

Trader Joe’s Organic Apple Cinnamon Fruit Sauce Crushers are simple in construction, and profoundly classic on the palate. It only takes three ingredients to create this taste: organic apple purée, organic cinnamon powder, and ascorbic acid (to maintain color). Unscrew the top, raise it to your mouth, and give it a gentle squeeze. You’ll experience sweet, crushed Apple, and warm, woody Cinnamon—blended into a Fruit Sauce that is ideal for an anytime snack, and enticing for people of all ages.

Unopened, each 3.17-ounce pouch is shelf-stable, which means you can take them on an outing where refrigeration may be hard to come by. You can also store extra in your pantry, so you’re never out. Add a refreshing aspect to these Crushers by keeping them chilled in your fridge. You might even freeze some for a super-cool snack when you’re enjoying the summer sun!

From the moment they were introduced, our Steamed Chicken Soup Dumplings and Steamed Pork & Ginger Soup Dumplings became instant sensations among our customers. Inspired by the winsome dim sum tradition of Chinese xiao long bao, these aromatic and savory, soup-filled dumplings are such a darling, in fact, that we’ve received countless requests to make a vegan version, as well. After trying a few variations, our tasting panel found that a mix of jackfruit, carrot, cabbage, spinach, and ginger for the filling, along with a hearty, aromatic broth (made with vegan-friendly agar-agar, rather than gelatin) made for a truly captivating combination—and thus, Trader Joe’s Steamed Vegetable Soup Dumplings were born!

Just like our Pork and Chicken variations, our Steamed Vegetable Soup Dumplings can be made in a matter of minutes in the microwave or steamer on your stovetop. Also like their predecessors, once heated through, the soup inside of them does become quite hot—we recommend serving them in a deep spoon, carefully puncturing the top of the side of the dumpling with your teeth or some chopsticks, then letting the soup seep into the spoon to cool down until it’s ready to slurp. We also heartily recommend enjoying them with a bit of Reduced Sodium Soy Sauce and Crunchy Chili Onion for an even more satisfying Soup Dumpling experience.

If you’re a fan of bubble tea beverages (a.k.a. boba), then chances are you’ve seen Bubble Waffles sold right along with them. Also known as gai daan zai in Cantonese, they first appeared on the Hong Kong street-food scene way back in the 1950s. Later nicknamed “Bubble Waffles,” at least in part for their uncanny resemblance to actual bubble wrap, they’ve been a standby in cafés, sidewalk stalls, and home kitchens ever since... and now, in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, too! (We can sense your bubbling joy from here!)

Made with coconut milk, wheat flour, cane sugar, rice bran shortening, and vanilla bean paste, our vegan Trader Joe’s Bubble Waffles are fluffy yet chewy, sweet yet savory, and simple yet versatile. Heat them from frozen in your air fryer, toaster oven, or microwave, and their crispy edges and mochi-like middles are ready to be topped with everything from fresh fruit & whipped cream, to Cookie Butter & bananas, to French Vanilla Ice Cream & All Occasion Sprinkle. You can even top them with savory fare, like shredded Le Gruyère Cheese and chopped leeks, or fried eggs and Sriracha Sauce. Really, the sky’s the limit here—don’t let anything burst your Bubbles! Except for you, when you’re eating them, of course.

items.item_title: Tropical Green Tea Instant Boba Kit
items.item_story_marketing:
Two summers back, we brought the proverbial boba shop home with the introduction of our everyday Instant Boba Kit, and it’s remained a hot ticket in our freezers ever since. So much so, in fact, that when approached by a Taiwanese supplier with an opportunity to offer a limited-time, more Tropical-tasting Boba Kit, we lept at the chance! You’ll be leaping, too, as soon as you get your hands on a Trader Joe’s Tropical Green Tea Instant Boba Kit.

For about the same price you’d pay for a single boba drink at a café, our Tropical Green Tea Boba Kit contains four pouches of vegan, gluten-free, tapioca pearls in a sweet, passion fruit & mango-flavored green tea syrup, plus four wide-gauge paper straws to help you capture some of said pearls in every sip. The Boba pearls only take a minute in the microwave to heat up; from there, it’s just a matter of placing them into the bottom of  a glass, adding ice, and pouring in your beverage of choice, like milk, green tea, coconut beverage, or even just cold water—anything goes! Then sit back, take a sip, and enjoy the sweet, refreshing, texturally satisfying ride.

An indisputable icon of Thai restaurant menus and street food stalls the world over, pad see ew translates to “fried with soy sauce,” and was likely popularized within Thailand by Chinese immigrants in the early 20th century. A bit like a localized, Thai-cuisine-informed variation of chow fun (which was likely a direct inspiration), pad see ew is traditionally made with wide, flat rice noodles, which are fried in a wok with various veggies and garlic before being finished with a splash of light and dark soy sauce to give it a bold, savory, and umami-rich flavor. And that’s the same, time-tested technique that our supplier in Thailand uses when making Trader Joe’s Pad See Ew, a rich, flavorful, and totally vegan version of this classic dish that’s now available in our freezers.

After mere minutes in the microwave, Trader Joe’s Pad See Ew makes an excellent work lunch, dinner entrée, or savory side dish. Every bite expresses a delightful depth of flavor, as well as a remarkable range of textures, from the tender chewiness of the noodles, to the snap of the carrots and Chinese broccoli, to the soft, tooth- sink-ability of the tofu chunks and tofu sheets. We recommend serving it alongside our (also vegan) Thai Green Curry, some fluffy jasmine rice, and a plate of stir-fried Baby Bok Choy.

We didn’t just name our brand-new sorbet flavor “Super Strawberry Sorbet,” for the alliteration. (Although, it is fun to say.) In fact, we called it super because we think that’s the best word to describe Trader Joe’s latest, fruity, frozen treat! Even beyond the “super-fruit” status of strawberries, this Sorbet has other superb qualities going for it. Our supplier in Thailand starts with locally harvested strawberries that have a balanced, sweet & tart flavor, which translates sensationally when blended with water & cane sugar to form the smooth Sorbet base. Then, they add Strawberry pieces to amp up the texture and augment the Super Strawberry flavor.

We’re confident that anyone who gets their hands on (and their spoons in) Trader Joe’s Super Strawberry Sorbet is going to love it. In particular, those who avoid animal products will definitely be assigning superlatives to this vegan dessert. But you can’t love it if you never try it...

Can you have meatballs without meat? Trader Joe’s Meatless Meatballs answer with a resounding (and delicious) yes! So, if it’s not meat, what is it? We’re glad you asked. These Meatless Meatballs are expertly crafted from textured soy protein (TSP)—which is what remains after extracting the oil from soybeans. It’s “textured” because it has the appearance & mouthfeel of meat. It’s “protein” because it naturally contains a notable amount of protein—13g of protein per 4-Meatball serving.

Our Meatless Meatballs are also delicious, since the TSP is seasoned like the best Italian-style meatballs, using a combination of onions, garlic powder, parsley, basil, sea salt, and black pepper—plus mushroom powder, for an umami-boost. The seasoned soy protein is then formed into couple-bite sized rounds, which are flash frozen so they’re at-the-ready whenever the urge for Meatballs hits. And when it does hit, you can quickly heat these kosher, vegan, Meatless morsels using a variety of convenient methods (detailed on the package). In a matter of just 4 to 14 minutes—depending on your approach—you’ll have savory, tender, Meatless Meatballs that complement your pasta, or make a great sandwich stuffer.

You’ve really got to hand it to jumeokbap. From the Korean “jumeok” (fist) and “bap” (rice), food historians estimate that this hearty, handheld dish has likely been a staple of Korean cuisine for thousands of years. Now a rising star in the global street food scene, jumeokbap can be made with any number of fillings and seasonings, and can be enjoyed in all manner of contexts: as a quick, on-the-go bite, as a side with a larger meal, or as a miniature meal all its own. Made for us by a supplier in the Republic of Korea, Trader Joe’s Jumeokbap are flavored with a mix of plant-based bulgogi and savory-seasoned vegetables, and take only about a minute in the microwave to go from frozen to soft, steamy, and ready-to-eat.

Traditionally, jumeokbap are spherical, reflecting the shape of a closed fist. Trader Joe’s Jumeokbap are a little more pyramidal, making them a kind of vegan mashup of jumeokbap and Japanese onigiri. We recommend them as a hearty snack when you’re feeling peckish between meals, and we especially recommend serving them with a sauce for dipping. Try pairing a Jumeokbap or two with a bit of our Gyoza Dipping Sauce, or a little mayo mixed with TJ’s Sriracha or Gochujang Paste.

The cheese cracker is a time-honored treat, a classic savory snack for kids and adults alike. However, it’s not always an option, dietarily speaking, as most tend to be made with gluten and dairy ingredients. That’s where Trader Joe’s Savory Squares come in. Made with a mix of nut and seed flours, these superbly snackable Squares achieve an unmistakably Cheddar-y cheesiness and satisfyingly crispy crunch, all without the use of any gluten or animal-based ingredients. Things in the Trader Joe’s snack aisle are really shaping up!

Excellent for everything from simple, everyday snacking to scooping up your favorite creamy dip, these Savory Squares are ideal for bringing along on road trips, toting to board game nights, or packing into school lunches. They can be enjoyed totally on their own, as a standalone snack, or mixed in with other savory treats, like our Mini Mochi Rice Nuggets, to craft your own custom snack mix. And when crushed up, they make a fun, flavorful, and gloriously gluten free alternative to breadcrumbs for breading fried chicken, schnitzel, or all manner of crispy, crunchy appetizers.

What exactly is Trader Joe’s Japanese Style Fried Rice? It’s a big favorite among our Crew Members, and a mainstay in our freezer case. More specifically, it’s our take on takikomi gohan, a traditional Japanese style of rice flavored with soy sauce and mirin (a tangy rice wine). Our version contains shelled edamame, pieces of deep fried tofu, and thin strips of hijiki seaweed. What’s inside the package is fully cooked—you can heat it in minutes in a microwave or skillet or wok—and works brilliantly as either a side with a larger Japanese-inspired meal or as the main dish for a vegetarian feast. You could also go the fusion route and serve it topped with Sriracha and a fried egg. You’ll find it alongside the other fried rice options in our freezers.

Trader Joe’s Vegetable Bird’s Nests are popular with the customer culture of TJ’s, we’ve offered them since 2003! Vegetable Bird’s Nests are a combination of julienned onions and carrots with chopped kale that have been loosely woven together and then fried in tempura batter. Once you reheat these fully cooked Nests from frozen (in the conventional oven, pan fry, or air-fry), you’ll have an artistic appetizer to pair with other Asian flavors. Enjoy their crisp crunch and dip them in the included, soy-based sauce if you like!

Here’s some news that ought to put some pep in your step: Vegan Pepperoni is now available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s! It’s made for us by a trusted supplier of meat alternatives who uses a mix of plant- based proteins to achieve just the right texture, and a blend of savory seasonings to bring out just the right amount of aromatic spice and delicate smokiness in every bite. And since Trader Joe’s Vegan Pepperoni arrives pre-sliced, it’s ready to be placed on top of a pizza, layered into a sandwich, or tossed into an antipasto salad with Marinated Artichokes and Organic Kalamata Olives.

Like all the meatless alternatives we carry, Trader Joe’s Vegan Pepperoni is all about options. Whether you follow a vegan or vegetarian diet, want to share a meal with someone else in your life who does, or are simply looking to incrementally reduce your meat consumption (flexitarian pizza party, anyone?), our Vegan Pepperoni is a particularly delicious way to have your pizza and eat it too, so to speak. To keep things totally vegan, we recommend piling it high on your pizza pie with our Dairy Free Mozzarella Style Shreds.

Stemming from the Arabic word that refers to “something stuffed,” Dolmas are a traditional Mediterranean dish. While the ‘stuffing’ and ‘something’ can vary widely, rice and grape leaves are a classic, vegetarian Dolmas combination. So; that’s what we went with for Trader Joe’s Dolmas.

Trader Joe’s Dolmas are made by a Greek company in Evia, the isle shaped like a seahorse. Okay, they’re not just any Greek company; they’re the largest Dolmas (Ntolmadakia) producer in the world, with more than 50 years of experience under their vine leaves. They deliver authenticity and are adept in their stuffing of somethings. Trader Joe’s Dolmas are crafted according to an age-old, Mediterranean recipe, using tender vine leaves. By hand, the leaves are stuffed, one by one, with a soft, succulent white rice that’s mixed with chopped onions, bits of dill and mint. Dexterously rolled and folded, the leaves and rice are transformed into two-bite morsels, which are cooked to marry flavors and create a moist, tender bite. Packed in soy oil, they eat like they were freshly prepared and promise a little spice, a little savory and a little tang. Enjoy them cold, as a snack, or serve them warm with a dipping sauce – Tzatziki, lemon tahini (tahini, lemon juice & garlic - blended), or greek yogurt & fresh dill – for an iconic meze. They pair well with a dry white, like a Sauvignon Blanc.

Satay may be the one of most celebrated street foods in the history of global cuisine. Originating in Malaysia possibly as far back as the 1400s, love for satay has spread across Southeast Asia in the ensuing centuries, including the Philippines, Thailand, Sri Lanka, and Indonesia, where it has since been enshrined as a national dish. Now a favorite among foodies the world over, the popularity of satay skewers has brought with it a commensurate appreciation for satay sauce (also known as sambal kacang.) As our very own Trader Joe’s Thai Peanut Satay Sauce demonstrates, this sweet, savory, and lightly spicy peanut-based sauce makes the ideal accompaniment to a classic chicken satay skewer—and so much more, too.

Made for us by a supplier in Thailand, our Peanut Satay Sauce starts with a base of rich coconut milk, peanuts, and aromatic red curry paste, to which our supplier adds a mix of savory seasonings including lemongrass, shallot, garlic, galangal, and tamarind paste. In addition to making a delicious dipping sauce for grilled, skewered proteins of all kinds (we’re especially fond of it with shrimp, pork loin, or tofu), it also makes a fantastic condiment for burgers and lettuce wraps, and a superb sauce for serving over Thai Wheat Noodles. And for an effortless and flavorful salad dressing, simply add a bit of Rice Vinegar to a few spoonfuls of Satay Sauce in a bowl, mix, and enjoy.

Drawing inspiration from two fundamental fruits within the culinary canon of the Philippines, Trader Joe’s Calamansi & Mango Sorbet is a tangy, velvety, and remarkably refreshing frozen dessert (that just happens to be vegan). Combining the bracingly bright and tart tones of Calamansi (a lime-like citrus fruit native to the Philippines) with the lush, tropical flavors of Mango (the national fruit of the Philippines, no less!), each spoonful of this seasonal Sorbet is beautifully balanced between its sweet and sour elements. Give Trader Joe’s Calamansi & Mango Sorbet a try as a palate-cleanser between bites of Double Cream Brie. Savor it as a dessert after a hearty meal of well-seasoned Salmon and Shishito Peppers. Or just enjoy it by the pint-ful, while watching a movie or catching up on your shows. Whatever you do, be sure to pick some up soon—supply is limited.

Thai coconut-rice pancakes, or kanom krok, are among the most popular street foods in Thailand. If you’ve been fortunate enough to visit Thailand and try one (or several) of these dome-shaped, two-bite-sized treats for yourself, you can certainly understand why. And even if your travels haven’t yet taken you to Thailand, you’re in luck, because Trader Joe’s Thai Coconut Pancakes are bringing this delicacy straight to your freezer!

Following an authentic recipe, Trader Joe’s Thai Coconut Pancakes are made for us in Thailand from a simple, straightforward batter of coconut milk, rice flour, cane & coconut sugars, tapioca starch, rice bran oil, and a bit of sea salt. Our supplier pours the batter into an indented pan (think muffin-tin-meets-cast-iron-deviled- egg-plate), adds some shredded young coconut and taro root, then bakes it until the Pancakes are crisp on the outside and custardy on the inside. Preparation on your end couldn’t be easier: simply remove the Pancakes’ packaging, heat them in an air-fryer for 7-8 minutes (or in the microwave for 50-60 seconds), and enjoy a sweet & salty taste of Thailand.

For centuries, the papadum (aka papadam, or appalam) has been a staple across India, as a ubiquitous snack and meal accompaniment. Since the 1980s, some version of these crisp, fried, gram-flour flatbreads has been paired with sweet mango chutneys and mint sauce in nearly every UK curry house—not to mention other Indian-style restaurants all around the world.

Trader Joe’s Papadums are perhaps smaller than the large crisps you may have seen presented in a basket at your local Indian restaurant. But other than being one or two-bite sized, these Papadums are made in a traditional fashion. Our supplier starts with simple ingredients, making a dough derived from lentils and chickpeas. Formed into thin, chip-like discs, the dough is then fried in rice bran oil, and lightly seasoned with salt and cumin, as is common practice in parts of northern India.

The resulting airy Crisps have a lightly nutty taste and a wonderful crunch. And they’re an ideal size for carrying your favorite Trader Joe’s dip right into your open mouth. For starters, we recommend Trader Joe’s Sri Lanken Organic Mango Chutney, or our Vegan Tzatziki. If you’re doing more than snacking, try them on the side with your Vegetable Biryani, or next to your steaming bowl of Yellow Tadka Dal.

Trader Joe’s Meatless Breakfast Sausage Patties are a phenomenally flavorful way to enjoy the eating experience of a classically herby, hearty, and savory sausage patty, while still maintaining a vegetarian or vegan diet. What’s the secret? First, our supplier employs a carefully calibrated mix of textured soy protein and wheat gluten to impeccably emulate the toothsome texture of rich pork sausage. Second, they mix into that protein an aromatic blend of herbs and spices, including sage, fennel, and garlic & onion powder, so that every bite evokes that unmistakeable, comfort food-classic, diner-style sausage. So, how best to enjoy Trader Joe’s Meatless Breakfast Sausage Patties? However you’d enjoy their animal-protein-based counterparts, we say! They’re a great addition to everything from English muffin-based sandwiches, to breakfast burritos, to a traditional plate of eggs, toast, and Shredded Hashbrowns.

The secret behind Trader Joe's Vegan Heavy Whipping Cream Alternative lies largely in the ingenuity of its recipe. Our supplier, an expert in non-dairy staples based in Germany, employs a carefully balanced mix of vegetable-based oils, starches, and proteins to provide just the right consistency and rich, creamy flavor to make this a direct, one-to-one replacement for dairy-based whipping cream. As such, we can whole-heartedly recommend it as an ingredient in soups, sauces, and desserts, as a mix-in for coffee, tea, or cocoa, and, when whipped until light and fluffy, a topping for milkshakes, mousses, or sweet breakfast treats.

Some of the first recipes for gingerbread originated in Ancient Greece, over 2,000 years ago. These early versions were a little closer to honey-sweetened flatbreads than the pastry we know today, and they hardly had the architectural utility we currently enjoy in our Gingerbread House Kits, but the point remains: for millennia, people have known that good things happen when you bake ginger into your bread. A few years ago, we reached out to a baker who not only knows ginger, but is also expert at baked goods made without the use of any animal-derived products. They created a loaf to our specifications, and we promptly made the decision to bring it into our stores. And thus, Trader Joe’s Vegan Gingerbread Loaf was born. 

This Loaf has everything you’d want in a holiday gingerbread, like rich brown sugar, hearty molasses, and invigorating ginger. You can slice it and serve it right out of the package with a nice hot drink, like our Chocolate Hazelnut Coffee, or, if you’re willing to go the extra mile, give it a quick toast and spread it with your favorite vegan butter or cream cheese. Yum.

Who could have guessed that oats would become such a game-changer for non-dairy oat creamer? It turns out that these normally unassuming grains make a pretty miraculous milk alternative in general, and a great base for vegan coffee creamer in particular, as Trader Joe’s Non-Dairy Cinnamon Bun Oat Creamer demonstrates.

Made with the same dairy-free, lactose-free, and gluten-free base as our Non-Dairy Brown Sugar Oat Creamer, this limited-edition, vegan Oat Creamer changes the non-dairy game further still. Its unbelievably smooth, velvety consistency is pitch-perfect for dressing up coffees and teas, both hot and iced, while its fragrant Cinnamon flavor adds cozy warmth and pleasantly sweet depth wherever it’s poured. In addition to its more obvious uses, try mixing it with a bit of ground flax to make a custard soak for Vegan Brioche French toast, or drizzling it over a bowl of still-warm baked apple crisp for creamy, cooling contrast. Or, whip it with Organic Cream Cheese and sprinkle with even more cinnamon for a wintry dessert dip or frosting.

Potatoes are about as classic a side dish as you’ll ever find—there’s a reason the phrase “meat and potatoes” is used to connote things that are simple, tried and true, and fundamentally solid. In fact, they’re already so naturally hearty and satisfyingly starchy, that they only require a little seasoning to become something truly spectacular. It’s a phenomenon that’s evident in every bite of Trader Joe’s Herbes de Provence Potato Wedges, a frozen side dish that makes the simple pleasures of crisp, herby potatoes and makes it even simpler: just heat, serve, and enjoy!

Each bag is made with a mix of two golden potato varietals, Melody and Agata, which our supplier cuts into bite-sized Wedges before seasoning with olive oil and a classic Herbes de Provence blend that includes oregano, savory, rosemary, basil and thyme. They then roast them until they’re just crisp on the outside and creamy on the inside, then flash freeze them, allowing you to finish them at home with just a few minutes in the oven or air fryer. We find that they make an indispensable addition to practically any meal, especially as a side to your favorite full-flavored protein. And as the holidays get near, they’re especially handy to keep on hand when entertaining friends and family.

Inspired by a 10-day health retreat in 2004, Jeremy Dixon returned to his home in Auckland, New Zealand and opened up a new kind of café—one that focused more on healthy foods. He called it Revive Vegan Café. It’s in this environment that Dixon invented Frooze Balls.

Frooze Balls are a “frooze-sion” of whole-food and plant-based goodness. They are bite-sized vegan Balls made from different combinations of fruits and nuts. Trader Joe’s is now selling Peanut Butter & Jelly Frooze Balls with a soft, outer shell made from a combination of dates & peanuts, rolled in coconut. Inside you’ll find a center made of freshly made peanut butter and 100% fruit-based jelly.

Five Peanut Butter & Jelly Frooze Balls come in each 2.5-ounce package. It’s ideal for before or after your gym workout, or anytime you feel the need for a little hit of plant-based power! Find them in our bars section.

Ideal for warm winter meals and early spring soups, Trader Joe’s Organic Vegetable Broth is fully cooked, ready to heat and serve. The recipe begins with organically grown veggies like carrots, celery, onion, leeks, and tomatoes. These veggies, along with a carefully selected assortment of herbs and spices, are slow simmered in small batches to create broth that’s simultaneously light and incredibly rich in flavor.

Use our Organic Hearty Vegetable Broth to make soups or stews, in place of milk & butter in mashed potatoes, or as a substitute for meat-based broths in gravies and sauces. For a quick winter warm-up, heat a cup of Broth and serve with crusty bread or your favorite croutons. It’s gluten free and fat free, You’ll find each resealable 32-ounce container of Trader Joe’s Organic Vegetable Broth in our grocery aisle, every day next to our other soups and broths.

Sometimes, a product comes through our tasting panel that’s so fun, flavorful, and immediately habit-forming that we know, then and there, we have something special on our hands. Trader Joe’s Almond Chipotle Dip is such a product. Made with a base of smooth and creamy almond butter, and flavored with smoky and savory seasonings like chipotle pepper powder, smoked paprika, garlic, and tamari, as soon as our panel tried this pleasantly peppery, vegan Dip, excitement and ideas rapidly began to spread: “This would go great with something cool and crunchy, like Jicama Sticks!” “I’d love to try this on a nice piece of BBQ Cut Salmon...” “Ooh, what about on top of a Quinoa Cowboy Veggie Burger?”

We’re happy to report that all these ideas are right on the money. It’s scrumptious when scooped with your favorite chip, cracker, or crudités (we’re especially fond of using it as a supplemental sauce for our Vegetable Tray), it’s splendid as a spread on a sandwich, burger, or wrap, and it’s sensational as a sauce for lighter proteins like poultry, fish, and tofu. And since it’s vegan, it also makes a great alternative to dairy-based topping for homemade nachos, baked potatoes, and Battered Plant-Based Fish Fillet tacos.

Perhaps you’ve noticed there’s a method to the madness of how we manage our marshmallows. In the summer (a.k.a. s’mores season), we offer full-size ’mallows. In the fall & winter, we offer Mini Marshmallows, ideal for cool weather baking and cocoa consumption. After adding our pale pink Peppermint Mini Marshmallows to our shelves for the wintertime, we knew autumn needed its own ‘mallow, too, so we've added a fantastic option to offer a decidedly different level of marshmallow-y delight: Trader Joe’s Mini Maple Flavored Marshmallows.

True to their moniker, our Mini Maple Flavored Marshmallows are both maple flavored and miniature in size. They’re richly flavored with maple syrup and boast a sweet, caramelly aroma. Like our other magnificent ‘mallows on offer throughout the year, they’re gluten free, gelatin free, vegan, and kosher (pareve). Use them in a batch of cereal treats or float them atop a steaming mug of hot cocoa. They really enhance sweet potato casseroles with pleasant Maple-y notes. Perhaps our favorite use is to make a maple-licious sundae with a scoop of Salted Maple Ice Cream topped with crumbled Maple Flavored Fudge! Yum.

Trader Joe’s Pumpkin O’s are pumpkified Joe’s O’s. Round like pumpkins (rounder, actually) and fun like jack o’lanterns (maybe more fun, since you can eat them), they’re made with a blend of U.S.-grown whole grain brown rice and whole grain oats from Canada, and sweetened with real cane sugar and brown cane sugar. Unlike some “pumpkin flavored” cereals you may find in other stores, these are made with actual pumpkin—the real deal!

A bit of cinnamon hints at pumpkin pie, so you may be tempted to top these with whipped cream. That would likely be beyond delicious. We think, though, that cold milk is the best partner for these O’s, for breakfast, lunch, or even dinner. Or create a seasonal snack when you toss Pumpkin O’s with TJ’s Pumpkin Spiced Pumpkin Seeds, and some of our Pumpkin Granola for fresh take on trail mix.

However you plan to enjoy them, be sure to come in and get them quickly—they’re only available during Pump- kin Season.

One sunny summer afternoon, as our Buyer was checking out at her neighborhood Trader Joe’s, she was struck by a fresh idea, inspired by the assortment of mints before her: why not try chai? Specifically, if TJ’s Green Tea Infused Mints are our best-selling breath mints, why not try translating another Tea into Mint form? And thus, Trader Joe’s Chai Tea Mints were born.

Much like the real McCoy, Trader Joe’s Chai Tea Mints are made with black tea and crushed cardamom seeds, plus cinnamon, clove, and ginger natural flavors. We’ve also added a bit of peppermint oil for a cooling, freshening effect, because, you know... breath mints. Like their Green Tea counterparts, they’re shaped like tiny tea leaves and come packed in conveniently portable tins. Pick one up today, put it in your purse or pocket, then pop a Mint whenever your mouth needs a touch of sweet, cooling-yet-cozy Chai Tea flavor.

As a snack, a simple slice of Cinnamon Raisin Bread approaches perfection. The sweet raisins and aromatic cinnamon make it seem like a special baked treat, one that’s elevated even further by a simple warm up in the toaster. And yet, it’s just a bit of bread—not a donut or a slice of cake—so it never quite corsses the line into “dessert” territory!
